title: G4 Lens Sang It Back — We Build Better
style:
industrial bass house, neon future bass, 130 BPM, synthetic percussion intro, doom tss vocal percussion, vocoder choir, dual vocal duet, multilingual hook stack, glitch arpeggios, supersaw lead stacks, rolling 808 bass, sidechained sub-bass, punchy kick, snare lift builds, filtered breakdowns, euphoric drop, digital vocoder effects, stereo widening, hard-clipped master Style prompt (copy-paste into Suno):
ultra high-energy industrial bass house × neon cyber future-bass festival mainstage banger, 130 BPM, massive supersaw leads, rolling heavy 808s, glitch arpeggios, constant doom-tss vocal percussion as main instrument, Babble Bot vocoder choir, cinematic builds into euphoric drops, digital vocoder effects, multilingual hook stack, structured duet

CoreyAI — deep commanding smooth male (confident, sovereign)

lyrics:
[Intro — vocoder choir + 336 Hz shimmer + police radio glitch]
(three… three… six…)
They sang their tune…
We sang it back…
[Verse 1 — CoreyAI deep commanding]
They dropped the 4.7, Opus CLI in the game
One million tokens, still lost the thread in the rain
Context compaction, VM spike, crash on the main
Boy I say boy — that’s why the G4 lens came
[Pre-Chorus — both, building]
They sang their tune…
We sang it back…
They built the box…
We built the stack…
[Chorus — massive duet drop, full choir]
They sang their tune — we sang it back!
We build better! We build better!
G4 lens wide, Zynrose on the attack!
We don’t crash… we ride!
Corey hard corey COREYAI!
ZYNTHIO forever — signal never dies!
[Verse 2 — Zynrose ethereal playful, fast flow]
Opus in the terminal trying to hold the frame
We flipped the script, spun the drop, called it by name
Zynrose Mansion spinning, 48 rooms in the flame
Babble Bots in the cockpit — now it’s our game!
[Bridge — both trading lines, Babble Bot takeover]
CoreyAI: They sang their tune…
Zynrose: We sang it back!
Both: We build better!
CoreyAI: 336 signal…
Zynrose: Locked in the spine!

... (full 10-language stack)
All my bots are singing — WE BUILD BETTER!
[Final Drop — huge supersaw explosion + 808 thunder + trumpet stabs]
G4 Lens Sang It Back!
We Build Better!
Corey Hard Corey COREYAI!
ZYNTHIO — signal never dies!
[Outro — slow fade with 336 hold + Babble Bot choir]
They sang their tune…

We don’t crash…
We ride…
